language.match: First supported zh* or en* in navigator.languages; fallback navigator.language; otherwise en
language.manualOverride: Immediate and persistent; languagechange ignored until system is selected again
language.figmaBoundary: Localized preset views; actual system detection and preference persistence are verified in the HTML prototype

components.font: Noto Sans SC; browser reference uses Noto Sans CJK SC
components.inputs: Editable native frames and text matching HTML geometry; interactive typing remains in HTML.

settings.sourceConfig: Address/scope, domain and target, cadence, first-history scope and exclusions; detect existing values before asking.
settings.sourceLifecycle: Detect → preview exact scope → explicit confirmation → effective receipt → observe first collection; enable is distinct from successful sync.
settings.sourcePause: Stops new collection; keeps evidence and existing work. Disconnect stops future access without cancelling work or deleting shared credentials.
settings.backupTarget: Input only when missing or explicitly changed
settings.diagnostics: Inspect approved scope; validate exact draft; trusted apply receipt; separate recheck

slogan.zh: 让你的判断，持续向顶尖进化。

brand.truthfulState: Running describes service availability, not task completion; waiting and one blocked executor do not stop a healthy service indicator
brand.sloganPlacement: Below centered sidebar logo; sidebar is an overlay drawer on mobile.

motion.reducedMotion: Static logo plus truthful status; hidden browser tab pauses decoration
motion.priorExamples: Existing 320/220/280ms motion examples and video are v2.1 history; current 4.8-second logo assets and native loop are reused unchanged from v2.3.

visualReview.method: Compare native screenshots with DOM-captured HTML references; correct intrinsic text-box widths and selected radio marks.

limits: Figma is a preset-state prototype. Free text, arbitrary state persistence, live validation and contextual service receipts are demonstrated in the HTML prototype.
Counters are labelled sample data; production aggregation requires StatsSnapshot and authorized domain filtering.
Figma native logo loop is reused from v2.3; no new actual prototype playback recording is claimed.

workViews.taskIdentity: Shared task ID and authoritative status; pending questions and ongoing work are separate read views, not duplicate tasks.
workViews.completed: Retained in completed history outside the unfinished list.
workViews.decisionContinuation: Verified W-017 answer clears its pending question and updates the same task to running.

sourceOfTruth.method: Capture browser DOM and computed layout; reconstruct editable Figma text, SVG, auto-layout and reusable local controls.
sourceOfTruth.staticLegacyDSL: Historical v2.4 only; do not use it to overwrite current screens.
